ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the trip is decided on your own artifacts, and they converge on the same result. Trip TRP-02821 measured 4.05 km on the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02821), and under POL-RD-01 the trace figure governs over the rounded trip-record copy of 4.0 km. Against the booked optimal of 3.2 km (EV-TRIP-02821) that is an excess of 0.85 km, or 26.56% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (0.85 km > 0.8 km and 26.56% > 20%), so a route deviation IS established. It is not a MATERIAL deviation (0.85 km < 8.0 km and 26.56% < 50%), so no POL-RD-06 driver-profile check or conduct referral is triggered — and the driver's profile shows deviation_flags_90d = 0 over 314 completed trips in any event. Nothing reduces the excess: the chat log EV-CHAT-02821 has 0 messages (POL-RD-04 unavailable), there is no amended pickup or dropoff (POL-RD-05 unavailable), the vehicle is RYDE_X not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12 unavailable), and the traffic-advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02821-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the driver's 'Followed the app' statement, which cites no artifact, carries no weight (POL-RD-08). The money then is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 on the METERED fare (EV-FARE-02821): recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 7.0) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = 8.96, against a charged_total of 9.28, giving a refund of 0.32 before rounding. The surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, the only artifact that carries it. Because 0.32 is below the SGD 0.50 de_minimis_refund constant, POL-RD-02 directs NO_ACTION rather than a partial refund, and both advocates' own calculations on this point are accepted. There is no ERP, toll or surcharge line to correct under POL-RD-09 (0 ERP gantries, 0.00 tolls, 0.0 airport surcharge on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport), and no fare line lacks a counterpart, so no billing-integrity referral arises; the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. The charge stands exactly as it is. Confidence rests on the trip record, GPS trace and fare breakdown, all at weight_multiplier 1.0, so it is not capped below the 0.70 floor and no escalation under POL-RD-10 applies.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
